## Introduction

Innovating in technical areas such as software engineering and software testing,
I teach [courses](/teaching/index.qmd), conduct [research](/research/index.qmd),
write [papers](/research/papers/index.qmd) and a [blog](/blog/index.qmd), give
[presentations](/research/presentations/index.qmd), create
[software](/software/index.qmd), [serve](/service/index.qmd) organizations, and
co-host the [Software Engineering Radio](https://www.se-radio.net/) podcast.
Let's stay connected!

## Connection

Please stay in touch! I always enjoy hearing from people who are interested in
software engineering and software testing, so I hope that you will
[contact](/contact/index.qmd) me to ask a question, share an idea, or suggest a
collaboration.

I work hard to produce the highest quality content to serve people interested
in software engineering and software testing. It would be greatly appreciated
